summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K on Oct 6, 2026, disclosing daily transactions under its share repurchase programme initiated May 6, 2026, part of a DKK 15bn buyback running from Feb 4, 2026 over 12 months. The programme covers up to DKK 11.2bn of B shares to Feb 1, 2027. Weekly purchases of 245,000 B shares averaged DKK 248.77–253.30, bringing cumulative repurchases to 21,845,000 shares for DKK 6.447bn and treasury holdings to 50,644,876 B shares, 1.1% of capital. Watch execution pace and any programme expansion.
